name: Paper
description: A student's or a conference paper: a title page, the text, the notes and the bibliography, as the writer's usual layout and citation style set them.

source.name: The common shape of a term paper or a conference paper, as the student style guides have it
source.notes: The guides say what the page looks like, and that is in their layouts; this is only the order of the parts, which the guides agree on. The student style guides' own templates are based on this one.
